description: This file contains base OpenTelemetry tracing decorators and utilities for the Pipecat project, including classes and functions to enable tracing of class methods and functions with different attachment strategies.

classes.name: AttachmentStrategy
classes.description: Enum controlling how spans are attached to the trace hierarchy (CHILD, LINK, NONE).

classes.name: Traceable
classes.description: Base class providing OpenTelemetry tracing capabilities for objects.

methods.name: traced
methods.description: Decorator to add tracing to async functions within Traceable classes.

methods.name: traceable
methods.description: Class decorator to make a class traceable by inheriting from Traceable.
